_doc: Music edit. Track: 'Sounds Good' by Michael Ramir C. (Mixkit, Mixkit Stock Music Free License), instrumental funk, A major. Measured grid (arrange.py, transient-fitted): 119.985 BPM, downbeats 1.994 + 2.0003*n s (residual 3.4 ms) = the picture's own 120 BPM / 2 s doubling grid, so the track plays unstretched with src = film for the groove and every doubling (2, 4, 6 ...) lands on a bar line.

segments.label: mu.groove: src 0.00-51.57 -> film 0.00-51.57 (track bars -1..24). Full-band groove from frame 0; its breakdown (src 16-22) sits under Eiffel/Burj/clouds, its own re-entry at 24 under the airliners. Hard stop 30 ms before the 16th at 51.6, 25 ms fade: silent through the black frame 51.6-51.98.
segments.qa_ok: deliberate hard stop: the picture cuts to black 51.6-51.98 and the music must stop dead

segments.label: mu.drop: src bars 25-26 (51.99-55.99) -> film 51.99-55.99. Bar 25 is the track's loudest section (+0.6/+0.9 rel dB, the densest bars); its downbeat transient lands on 52.00 (the Moon). Enters from silence.

mu.ending: src 90.99-94.98 (beat 3 of bar 44 + the final chord at src 92.0 ringing down) -> film 55.99-59.98. Beat-to-beat splice (both strong beats at the same level, -12.8 / -14.3 dB): the 2-beat pickup into the final chord, which lands on 57.0 (the end card) and decays to silence by 60.
